top_signals.title: Robert Allan Announces New Ship-Handling/Fire-Fighting 2 Tug Design
top_signals.summary: Robert Allan Ltd. announced the award to design a new RAmparts 3800 Ship-Handling/Fire-Fighting 2 (FiFi 2) tug for Ningbo Port. The vessel will be constructed by Jiangsu Zhenjiang Shipyard (Group) Co., Ltd.Robert Allan Ltd. has built long term relationship with Ningbo Port since 2004…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
